coverage_note: Medi's Arabic is untranscribed as [speaking foreign language]/[speaking Arabic] from 14:11 to about 27:00 (apology drill, kul 7ada vs el-kul); only her chat lines show what was said, so rows 21:07/22:14 quote her side. From 27:46 to the end his Arabic is Latin transliteration in the ASR's own spelling (kharab, tadait, bitin bisti); Amal's Latin is kept as printed. Not written: S4 pronunciation slips (ma tarat for ma66arat 41:29, mazuja 58:48, stawarini 1:01:56), his self-fixes she then approved (sab3taash 08:34, bit'assif->it'assifi 30:52, matet 47:32), listening turn 23:30 where he read her kul 7ada sentence correctly, his question 36:06 about pointers in questions (answered, no utterance), 'pantalon' 13:03 (her sheet word ban6aloan), 'sausage' 07:33 which she allows aloud, and 'bidahik = I smile' 55:40 which her sheet lists as laugh/smile. Her 'يصلح' at 42:35 read as an echo, not a fix.
